company.name: Al Tadamun Microfinance Foundation
company.shortDescription: Al Tadamun Microfinance Foundation aims to meet the needs of underprivileged women micro-entrepreneurs for a source of financial setup.

productsAndServices.description: A loan product for micro-scale women entrepreneurs with small, individual, and multiple cycle working capitals to improve their enterprises. Loan size ranges from 10,000 to 15,000 EGP with a repayment period of 16, 21, or 26 payments.
productsAndServices.name: Group Loan Product

productsAndServices.description: A loan product for individual financing needs, supporting a diversified range of projects. Loan size ranges from 16,000 to 100,000 EGP with a repayment period of 12 to 30 payments.
productsAndServices.name: Individual Loan Product

productsAndServices.description: A loan product for larger financing needs, supporting projects with higher capital requirements. Loan size ranges from 101,000 to 242,000 EGP with a repayment period of 12 to 30 payments.
productsAndServices.name: Golden Loan Product

productsAndServices.description: A loan product for financing machinery, equipment, and vehicles such as sewing machines, photocopying machines, display fridges, plastic cutters, tricycles, and motor bicycles. Loan size ranges from 6,000 to 100,000 EGP with a repayment period of 12 to 30 payments.
productsAndServices.name: Family Loan Product for Machinery - Equipment & Vehicles

productsAndServices.description: A loan product launched in 2021 to finance active clients with machinery and equipment needed for their projects.
productsAndServices.name: Forsa Loan Product

productsAndServices.description: A loan product launched in 2023 to finance clients who have dropped out. Loan size ranges from 10,000 to 15,000 EGP with a repayment period of 6 to 12 payments.
productsAndServices.name: Khatwa Loan Product
